description: This Java source file defines a class `PolicyTrie` that implements a trie data structure for mapping resource keys to policies, optimized for policy enforcement. It includes methods for building the trie from policies, navigating, modifying, and generating views based on permissions and subjects.

classes.name: PolicyTrie
classes.description: A trie data structure for a policy optimized for enforcement, mapping resource keys into grant/revoke indices.

methods.name: fromPolicy
methods.description: Builds a PolicyTrie from an iterable collection of PolicyEntry objects, interpreting policies as trie nodes.

methods.name: getJsonKeyIterator
methods.description: Converts a ResourceKey into an iterator of JsonKey objects representing its path.

methods.name: seekOrCreate
methods.description: Finds or creates a node in the trie matching the given resource path.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: A wrapper around Map.compute() that updates or creates a child trie node.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Adds granted permissions for specified subjects at this node.

methods.name: revoke
methods.description: Adds revoked permissions for specified subjects at this node.

methods.name: getTransitiveClosure
methods.description: Returns a copy of the trie with grants and revokes inherited transitively from ancestors.

methods.name: getBottomUpGrantTrie
methods.description: Returns a copy of the trie with grants accumulated from descendants upward.

methods.name: getBottomUpRevokeTrie
methods.description: Returns a copy of the trie with revokes accumulated from descendants upward.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Generates a JSON object view of a resource, filtered according to permissions and subjects.
